Figma clay app icon artwork: one puffy, inflated, toy-like object in soft matte plastic, with chunky rounded shapes and at most three or four raised details. Front view, optically centred, occupying about 70% of the tile, no perspective. Choose a recognisable object for this app's job; individual games need distinct objects rather than a shared controller. Fill the square canvas edge to edge with a smooth light vertical gradient between neighbouring steps of one Matrix brand hue: green, teal, gold, blue, or neutral. Use a white or contrasting-hue object with one small accent in a third hue; neighbouring apps should have distinct tile colours. Soft studio light from the top-left, a soft downward shadow and one small top-left shine. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, outlines, busy scenes or transparency; no metal, glass, neon, glow, red or coral. The Matrix shell owns the final corner radius (22%), so do not bake a separate visible icon frame into the artwork. Keep the silhouette readable at 64, 48 and 20 pixels.
